title: NQO1 induction and radiation-based biodistribution study of a new quinoline derivative identified in a screen of 6,8-diiodoquinazolinone sulfonamide conjugates.
authors: Soliman, Aiten M; Ghorab, Mostafa M; Higgins, Maureen; Dinkova-Kostova, Albena T; Korany, Mohamed; Amin, Mohamed A; Khedr, Mohammed A; Sakr, Tamer M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究喹唑啉衍生物激活Nrf2通路及分子对接，虽含蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: A series of quinazoline derivatives 10-23 incorporating benzenesulfonamide and various aliphatic, aromatic and heterocyclic acetamide tails were designed, synthesized, and in vitro evaluated for their ability to activate nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) using its classical target NAD(P)H: quinone oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1) in Hepa1c1c7 murine hepatoma cells. Compounds 13 and 20 exhibited the highest potency among this series, with CD values 14 and 3 muM, respectively. The quinoline derivative 20 was subjected to radiolabeling. The radio-synthesized derivative was assessed for its biodistribution in normal and tumor-bearing animal models, where it displayed high in vivo stability and selectivity toward tumor cells. Molecular docking of 20 within the Nrf2-binding site of Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) predicted the highest binding affinity -8.76 kcal/mol with the least RMSD value 1.01 A. It showed a stable binding confirmed by RMSF compared to the co-crystallized ligand. This study identifies compound 20 as a promising antioxidant for continued optimization in redox-modulating research.
abstract_zh: 设计并合成了一系列含有苯磺酰胺及不同脂肪族、芳香族和杂环乙酰胺尾链的喹唑啉衍生物10-23，并在体外评估了其激活核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）的能力，采用其经典靶标NAD(P)H：醌氧化还原酶1（NQO1）在Hepa1c1c7小鼠肝癌细胞中进行测试。在该系列中，化合物13和20表现出最高的效力，其CD值分别为14和3 μM。将喹啉衍生物20进行放射性标记，并在正常和荷瘤动物模型中评估了放射性合成衍生物的生物分布，结果显示其具有较高的体内稳定性和对肿瘤细胞的选择性。对20在Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）的Nrf2结合位点进行分子对接，预测其结合亲和力最高为-8.76 kcal/mol，RMSD值最小为1.01 Å。与共晶配体相比，通过RMSF确认其结合稳定。本研究确定化合物20为一种有前景的抗氧化剂，可用于氧化还原调节研究的进一步优化。
